item.text: The bolt base is built. I’m checking the head proportions before adding the threaded section. You can follow the model in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd).

arguments.code:
import math
R=13.85
pts=[Vector(R*math.cos(math.radians(60*i)),R*math.sin(math.radians(60*i)),48) for i in range(6)]
pts.append(pts[0])
head=Part.Face(Part.makePolygon(pts)).extrude(Vector(0,0,9))
edges=[e for e in head.Edges if all(abs(v.Point.z-57)<0.001 for v in e.Vertexes)]
head=head.makeChamfer(0.8,edges)
shaft=Part.makeCylinder(8,48)
pitch=1.75
helix=Part.makeHelix(pitch,26.25,8)
profile=Part.Wire(Part.makePolygon([Vector(8.15,0,-0.55),Vector(7.45,0,0),Vector(8.15,0,0.55),Vector(8.15,0,-0.55)]).Edges)
cutter=Part.Wire(helix.Edges).makePipeShell([profile],True,True)
shaft=shaft.cut(cutter)
result=head.fuse(shaft).removeSplitter()
arguments.label: Chamfered hex head and helical thread

item.text: The model now has a chamfered hex head and helical threads, and validation confirms one valid solid. The base matched the reference silhouettes closely; the final comparison render hit a system memory error. I’ll try the STEP export next.
Created `part.FCStd` and exported `submission.step`. STEP readback confirms one valid solid matching the model.
